audit_method_note: Re-checking pre-author findings against function_call_contract.yaml (JSON Schema 2020-12), SPEC.md §3, coredata-model.md.

resolutions.evidence: function_call_contract.yaml authored in JSON Schema 2020-12; declares dialect, $defs, required arrays, additionalProperties:false posture, sample valid+invalid for ask_back. L1.
function_call_contract.yaml#functions.ask_back.response_streaming defines TokenDelta AsyncStream with sentenceBoundary/isFinal. SPEC.md §3.4 declares back-pressure policy (queue depth ≤ 2). L8.

function_call_contract.yaml#$defs.Envelope wraps every return; $defs.Error enumerates 12 codes including MALFORMED_JSON, UNKNOWN_FUNCTION, LOW_CONFIDENCE, LOG_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, CONTEXT_OVERFLOW. fallback_action enum specifies recovery.
function_call_contract.yaml#orchestration §steps 1-8 sequence diagram in pseudocode + ablation_harness build flag. SPEC.md §3.3 narrates.
L11 / SPEC.md §10.1 BCP-47 canonical; function_call_contract.yaml $defs.BCP47 vs GemmaLanguageInput separated; Wonder.bcp47Locale vs Wonder.bcp47SecondaryLocale on coredata-model.md.

L9 / function_call_contract.yaml $defs.RegulatedAdviceCategory unions all 7 values: legal/medical/financial/welfare/insurance/emergency/other. proposed-design-delta.json doesn't yet include a delta to idea.spec.json#no_go to mirror; recommend adding for completeness, but enum is the source of truth so non-blocking.
L10 / mode enum renamed unspecified; mode_classify.returns adds mode_raw + chip_pattern. ModeChipPattern $defs in contract. coredata-model.md.Wonder.modeRaw.

function_call_contract.yaml $defs.CompressedHistoryV1 declares format (compressed-history-v1), payload (array of {t,mode,bcp47,summary,wonder_id}), token_count cap 32K. SPEC.md §2.1 reframes M01 narrative.
All 4 functions require turn_id: UUID. Wonder.turnId immutable field. SPEC.md §3.3 step 1 generates UUIDv4.
SPEC.md §12 External Surfaces — binding negative declaration enumerates 6 documented and ~20 absent surfaces; data-flow-diagram.md §3 mirrors.
SPEC.md §3.6 documents the inconsistency and reserves classify_mode alias for v1.1 minor. Acceptable as post-MVP; cleaner than late churn. Non-blocking.
function_call_contract.yaml surface_past_wonder.request.max_surfaced has min:0 max:5 default:1 with rationale in $defs comment.
Confidence $defs has range [0,1] + threshold note (<0.6 → unspecified). SPEC.md §3.3 step 5 hysteresis.

Envelope.schema_version const '1.0.0'; contract.contract_versioning_policy declares minor=additive, major=breaking. Wonder.inferenceFingerprint contains modelSHA256 + mlxSwiftVersion. AppMeta.schemaVersion. coredata-model.md §3 migration policy.
SPEC.md §12 declares AppleScript .sdef ABSENT; AX tree explicitly enumerated (caption + chip exposed; wondering log NOT exposed).

function_call_contract.yaml defer_to_human.response.deferred field documented as 'always true today; reserved for future state'; explanation_phrase has language + maxLength 200; suggested_resource_class is enum (ResourceClass). Localizable.strings keys referenced in SPEC.md §10.7. Non-blocking minor wording.

new_findings_iter1.issue: Streaming is defined but the relationship between stream_items and the terminal response_terminal envelope is not explicit. Does the orchestrator emit a final Envelope wrapping the concatenated text after streaming concludes? Or does the stream itself replace the envelope? Implementer ambiguity.
new_findings_iter1.spec_action_required: Clarify: 'streaming emits TokenDelta items WITHOUT envelope wrap; on isFinal=true, orchestrator additionally emits one Envelope wrapping the concatenated terminal response_terminal data shape.' One sentence in SPEC.md §3.4.

approval_rationale: All 4 pre-author blockings resolved. All 6 highs resolved. 2 of 4 mediums resolved-or-deferred-documented; 2 reframed (mode_classify rename, defer_to_human.deferred field) with acceptable rationale. 1 of 2 lows resolved; 1 deferred-documented. 1 minor new finding (medium, low-cost).
